title: The End
description: &eThe End&r is entirely optional for &dNTM&r progression, but is home to &6Trixite&r, a unique extraterrestrial mineral that when processed can yield &6Plutonium&r, &6Cobalt&r and &6Niobium&r. The Niobium is of great interest as it is a great source for early &3Catalytic Cracking Towers&r.
Due to only the main end island existing, Trixite Ore is a limited resource.&r Trixite Crystals can also be obtained from an &6Asteroid Mining Ship&r, but it is not recommended.
Enderman farms can also be made using &3Fans&r to push the endermen into the killing zone.
